design_status: WITHDRAWN durability calibration: stars were chosen using placeholder player offense. Retained for comparison only; offensive inputs are unresolved. Prior HTD calculations are separate from this offense error.
assumptions: Snuffiss defenses use the previous Season 8 snapshot and intended health modifier order.
Previous placeholder offense has been removed. See snuffiss-weapon-source.json for verified weapon inputs and unresolved timing.
SLS nominal health = base health * (1 + stars); raw damage = base damage * (1 + 0.25 * stars).
Brute requires Lightning and Frost; bear requires Lightning. Additional random modifiers can change these results.
SLS Lightning power is 0.4 + 0.05 * game level; Frost is 0.4 + 0.01 * game level. Game level is stars + 1.
Snuffiss has 57.728 percent lightning resistance and native 0.5 frost damage multiplier from chest armor.
Shaman melee is modeled. Its poison payload at 24 stars is 210 before defenses; poison timing and healing are not modeled.
Wave counts are design targets. PR 19 creature overrides do not guarantee exact wave composition.
Fixed managed stars require the PR 19 Fortress integration and compatible SLS spawn-management API.
Bear prefab Bjorn must be added to the shrine creature catalog. High stars also increase creature size.
